integrity: Proof of the all-size claim is explicit; finite exhaustive and recursive software tests independently corroborate selected sizes and do not substitute for the proof. Source comparisons limited as detailed in AUDIT.json.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns immediate one-step fixed states of strict open-neighbor majority on J(n,2); equivalence is ground-set relabelling, not every exceptional graph automorphism. It does not classify periods, basins or transients. A published general line-graph half-factor theorem covers an abstract unweighted fixed-state reduction, but does not state the evaluated ground-set orbit count. Historical originality is not independently certified.
title: Threshold-graph rigidity and a power-of-two equilibrium type law for triangular networks
